mintAuthority.summary: CJPY is minted permissionlessly from Yamato's Liquity-v1-style ETH pledges (130% MCR, one-time fee, no interest). The Yamato contract is a UUPS proxy (ERC1967Proxy) pointing to YamatoV4 implementation; upgrade authority (onlyGovernance) is held by a 2-of-4 Gnosis Safe at 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec with no modules. CJPY token is non-upgradeable with no owner; its own private governance variable has been permanently renounced (revokeGovernance), so its CurrencyOS pointer is fixed. CurrencyOS itself (which coordinates minting) is a separate UUPS proxy whose upgrade authority resolves to the same 2-of-4 Safe.

controls.label: Yamato pledge contract (ETH CDP mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by the 130% minimum collateralization ratio on ETH pledges, with redemption-based peg defense.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095940 on 2026-10-01, the Yamato proxy implementation slot still resolves to YamatoV4 0x0bfa59f9fbe9565c240cd64311c86e90e59a4838; its admin slot is zero. MCR() returns 130 and governance() returns 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec.

controls.label: Yamato governance Safe (upgrade + parameter authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095940 on 2026-10-01, governance() on the Yamato proxy returns 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec. The Safe retains the four recorded owners and threshold 2; getModulesPaginated returns an empty array and the guard storage slot is zero. The pinned Yamato/UUPSBase source gates upgrades and parameter changes through onlyGovernance.

controls.label: CJPY token private governance (renounced)
controls.capDescription: The pinned Currency.sol source declares a private `governance` slot that alone can call setCurrencyOS(); it exposes no public getter.
controls.evidence: Currency.sol declares address currencyOS followed by address governance after the inherited ERC20Permit storage. At Ethereum block 26095940 on 2026-10-01, slot 6 returns CurrencyOS 0xe69c6bf0a6ea2f12abe054988a3e2091a8a3784f and slot 7 remains zero. The pinned source only sets governance in the constructor or clears it in revokeGovernance(), leaving the token's CurrencyOS pointer fixed.

controls.label: CurrencyOS UUPS governance (Yamato Safe)
controls.capDescription: CurrencyOS.addYamato/setDeps (registering new Yamato mint sources) and its UUPS _authorizeUpgrade are both gated onlyGovernance.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095940 on 2026-10-01, CurrencyOS 0xe69c6bf0a6ea2f12abe054988a3e2091a8a3784f retains implementation 0x811ce73639a05f436a56ea71480cd921a4039542 and a zero EIP-1967 admin slot. governance() returns the same 2-of-4 Yamato Safe 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec. Its owners, threshold, empty module list and zero guard were re-read at that block; the pinned UUPSBase source gates replacement and mint-source administration through onlyGovernance.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295201: Yamato proxy (0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257) is an ERC1967Proxy (UUPS) pointing to YamatoV4 impl (0x0bfa59f9fbe9565c240cd64311c86e90e59a4838); proxy admin EIP-1967 slot = 0x0 (UUPS). governance() returns 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec (GnosisSafeProxy, 4 owners, threshold 2, no modules). CJPY token (0x1cfa5641c01406ab8ac350ded7d735ec41298372): EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x0, owner() reverts, immutable non-upgradeable token. Follow-up 2026-07-20: the Yamato pledge contract 0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257 exposes MCR()=130 and feePool() but no aggregate supply cap or debt ceiling getter; CJPY minting is bounded only by per-vault ETH collateral at the MCR, so the economic cap semantics are unbounded. Follow-up 2026-07-21: the CJPY token's own private governance/CurrencyOS route (previously unbound to the Safe) is now resolved by direct storage read, governance slot 7 is all-zero (permanently renounced via revokeGovernance(), no replacement setter exists), so the token's currencyOS pointer (0xe69C6Bf0A6eA2F12aBE054988A3e2091a8a3784f) is fixed. CurrencyOS is a separate UUPS proxy whose public governance() resolves to the same 2-of-4 Yamato Safe (0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec), which is also the sole authority for addYamato/setDeps and CurrencyOS upgrades. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the governance Safe can add mint sources or upgrade mint logic without an independent timelock; current issuance is fully on-chain ETH-collateralized with no off-chain reserve claim, and no prudential supervisor is named.
